_comment: CTR-TOK-24 size gate (scripts/size_gate.py). Contracts allowed over their limit, with the measured runtime size they may not exceed; `<name>.init` likewise for init code over EIP-3860. P6g: + the `_batchable` / `_uaEnvelopeBinding` hooks (+137 B on each token), the PQZ kinds `NoUnderlyingPqzToken` / `UnderlyingPqzToken` (deployed on chain 7622: `maxCodeSize` 65,536 from block 0, init 131,072). UA secp256k1: `UARegistry` 25,861 B. With the appended env (480 B + 32 B per dependency + 64 B per pinned library) `UnderlyingPqzToken` sends 63,975 B of init code (7622 limit 131,072); runtime still within 65,536 B. Review 5g-Z2 P2-2 (2026-10-20): the Zether constructor checks each verifier's role (two addresses, `ringSize()` answered by the transfer verifier only): init +259 B on both Zether kinds (`NoUnderlyingZetherToken` 49,757 B, `UnderlyingZetherToken` 61,936 B); runtime unchanged. Review T2 CHAIN-03 (2026-10-20, merged after 5g-Z2): `Math.mulDiv` in `FeePolicy.compute` (no overflow for amounts near 2^256): every token about +200 B, init likewise. UA-6 Task 9 (2026-10-20): every entry set to the measured merged size. Tokens and the PQZ kinds +16 B each (0x0141 joined `UAKinds.isSigning`, which is inlined into the tokens' receiver check; the PQZ holder shape moved to the registry); `UARegistry` -559 B (the 0x0140 kind and the pqz-mlwe-only path removed, the per-kind register dispatch simplified); the Zether kinds -305 to -355 B (the `authSig` BLS signature path removed). Final fix wave: `UARegistry` +9 B (`UAKinds.uaOf` now calls `_requireDerived`, so 0x0142 is refused, CTR-PQZ-13). Ratchet: the UA-6 numbers are the new ceilings. 5h Task 1 (2026-10-20, D14): PqzLib split into PqzStateLib / PqzTransferLib / PqzBurnLib / PqzViewLib (+ internal PqzCore); token sizes unchanged (the calls were already DELEGATECALLs), so no entry moves. 5h Task 2 (2026-10-20, D1-D9, D18, D24): the debit entry points lose `acc` / `inline` (an optional `accHint`), `pqzRollOver(ua, n)`, + `pqzPrepareAcc`, `pqzPending` / `pqzAcc` / `pqzPendingCt`, the `shieldIn` burn; `pendingHash` and `plainPending` gone: `NoUnderlyingPqzToken` 48,130 B (-267; init 50,652, -260), `UnderlyingPqzToken` 60,680 B (-158; init 63,209, -151), 760 B inside the 4 KiB target (no view fallback needed). Ratchet: the new numbers are the ceilings.
